name: Sharks
description: Sharks and very large rays at the top of the creek's food web - the source's 'Requin +' compartment, pooling the bull shark (Carcharhinus leucas) with two big ray species measured together with it (the bull ray Pteromylaeus bovinus and a torpedo ray, Torpedo sp.). They eat everything from rays and catfish to mullets and shrimps; their biomass was set by expert judgement ('one large shark or two medium ones in the bolong in a year'). Functional group pooling the source's Requin + compartment.
